verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents credential isolation rather than true scoped token issuance. Each agent gets separate workspaces, auth, and sessions; each fleet cell has its own credentials and token; node and computer use are capability-based; and secrets are handled via SecretRefs. None of this shows a way to mint least-privilege API credentials with restricted scopes for an agent. Missing for 10: a documented mechanism to issue scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens, per-token permission and scope definitions, a token revocation and rotation workflow for agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
